reference.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: contextual English A1 lesson exercise illustration, one standalone square image, opaque full-bleed environment. Create a polished soft 3D narrative illustration for the question 'How is Tom?' whose only correct answer is 'He’s tired.' Scene: a young adult man named Tom seated on a sofa in his modest contemporary living room after a long day, shoulders drooping, heavy eyelids, head supported by one hand, a clear yawn. A small lamp and muted evening window give context. Friendly professional educational 3D style, rounded modeling with realistic human proportions, tactile matte materials, soft natural lighting, restrained warm colors. Human character, NOT a floating emoji or toy figurine. Face and body language dominate; minimal uncluttered yet clearly visible room fills the entire background. Medium shot, waist-up, head and hands fully visible, centered in inner 70% safe area, readable at 170px. The emotion must read as exhaustion rather than sadness, cold or anger. Avoid tears, food, shivering, angry eyebrows, words, letters, labels, flags, logos, watermarks, borders, white or transparent backgrounds, collage. No caption or typography. Generate exactly this one scene.
